scope: Retain classifier-supported scalar values for unknown DXF HEADER variables, including their names and stored text under the configured retained-byte budget.
Serialize retained unknown vars and caller-provided customVars deterministically while keeping known variables on their field-specific canonical writer paths.

Fail closed on unsupported compounds/coordinate groups, out-of-range integer values, malformed names or string boundaries, duplicate aliases, and non-null translated references; validate both direct HEADER writing and adapter publication.

source.title: Autodesk DXF group-code value types
source.use: Typed retention uses the repository's shared DXF value-kind classifier, aligned with the published general group-code type ranges; multi-value and coordinate forms remain outside this scalar preservation profile.

tests: Generated ASCII/Binary HEADER controls cover unknown group-1 text, int16/int32/int64, finite double, bool, binary chunk, arbitrary handle spelling, and explicit null translated handle.
Round-trip checks include copy/assignment/move, UTF-8 values, deterministic repeated output, and caller customVars serialization.

Negative controls cover zero retained-byte budget, compound/multi-group and coordinate forms, non-null translated refs, case-variant canonical names, dollar/bare collisions, malformed handle spelling, out-of-range Int16, line-injection text, and sentinel-preserving adapter refusal.
validation: cmake --build build-gcc --target libdxfrw_dxf_fixture_tests lc3_compat_check --parallel 2: PASS (-Werror; compatibility target succeeds)
git diff --check on touched implementation/test files: PASS

limitations: This preserves only one-record scalar unknown variables whose group-code type and numeric range are supported by the shared classifier/writer. Unknown compounds, coordinate groups, unassigned binary forms, and non-null translated object references remain fail-closed.
No persistent drawing fixture, full suite, independent producer/native acceptance, or support-claim promotion was added. The generated evidence is local structural coverage only.
The DRW_Header layout now owns a retained-byte lease; downstream consumers must rebuild, and no binary ABI compatibility claim is made.
J256, J260, J268, J284, J293, and J295 remain DEFERRED_EXTERNAL; FreeCAD Linux/Windows and independent ACIS/ACDS semantic qualification remain separate open gates.
